text.en: The majority of clients speak highly of individual groomers and reception staff, praising their helpful approach and courteous handling. Specific groomers receive acclaim for delivering requested breed cuts accurately. However, mixed remarks note occasional delays in communication and feeling dissatisfied when concerns about incomplete grooming were not followed up promptly.

Pet owners consistently report that staff members treat visiting dogs with genuine affection and attentive care. Reviewers note feeling comfortable leaving their pets for daycare and grooming, highlighting that dogs return home happy and calm. Regular text updates regarding pet activities during visits provide significant reassurance to anxious owners.

Feedback regarding bath and styling results is largely favourable. Customers frequently mention clean, well-groomed dogs sporting neat breed-standard trims, including teddy bear faces and styled legs. While one client noted uneven finishing around the ears and paws on a doodle breed, most regular patrons report consistent, high-quality grooming outcomes.

q.en: What grooming styles are available at Lucky Dog Pet Retreat & Spa?

a.en: Reviewers mention requesting specific styled cuts, such as teddy bear faces and lamb legs, with groomers following detailed styling instructions.

q.en: Do pet owners receive updates during daycare and grooming visits?

a.en: Yes, clients note that staff send regular text messages with activity updates and pictures while pets are in their care.

q.en: How are drop-off times and appointments handled?

a.en: Services operate by appointment, though clients advise confirming expected pickup times at drop-off to avoid scheduling delays.
